Hover and signature help, for a client that shows plain text, counts in
UTF-8 and reads a parameter as its text: the same answers without the
marks.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
/* Grundläggande */ #define BASE "/std/base"
-- lib/std/base.c --
/*
 * Sets the weight.
 *   1. *Not* below zero.
 */
varargs void set_weight(int grams, string why...) {}
/* blåbær */ void create() {}
-- lib/obj/a.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit BASE;
void create() { /* først */ ::create(); set_weight(1, "å", "b"); ob->set_weight(2); sizeof(({ })); }
